page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening) with running text in one main column; a brace diagram in the middle of the column with a label "Sunt autem" and a second brace diagram "Quare" with boxes; marginal references to the right of braces, text otherwise full width. Left edge shows fragments of the facing page, not transcribed.

main_text.p: Pseudoprophetæ sunt hostes dissimulati, qui sub Christi nomine doctrinam ipsius oppugnant. 1.Ioa. 4.1. & 1.Ioa.7.
main_text.l: Sunt autem {Antichristi. / Antichristus, qui κατα ἐξοχὴν, sic dictus est, } 1.Ioa.2.18. 19.1.Ioa.4. 3.2.Ioa.7.
main_text.p: Antichristi sunt pseudoprophetæ omnes, qui ab Apostolorum temporibus suis imposturis viam apertam ad mysterium iniquitatis sive Antichristum maximum sternebant. ex praced. cum 2.Thess.2.7. 1.Ioa.4.3.
Antichristus est universalis apostasiæ futuræ caput. 1.Ioa.2.18. 1.Ioa.4.3. 2.Thes.2.4.5.6.
Unde synech. eius ecclesia (a) Antichristus dictus est (b) ut vera ecclesia Christus. (a) 1.Ioa.4.3. & 2.18. (b) 1.Cor.12.12.
main_text.l: Quare {Primo, de ecclesia Antichristiana. / Secundo, de capite Antichristo, illius ecclesiæ pseudopropheta. } dicendum.
main_text.p: Antichristiana ecclesia bestiæ comparata, est ecclesia apostatica, veræ tamen laruam effingens, quæ Romanorum monarchiæ prius deletæ, regiminis, potentiæ, & per omnes populos, amplitudinis sedisq; imaginem vivam representat. 2.Ioa.2.4.5.6.7.8.Apo. 11.7.8.& 13.3.11.12.13.14.15.16.17.18.

page.notes: Brace diagrams are transcribed as lines; the reference numbers beside them belong to the boxes. The word "Huius" at the foot right is a catchword. Some scanned words are faint; the Greek and Latin references are copied as printed.
